SUAS-007 — System Identifiers and Syntax

The seventh SuperUnicode Architecture Standard: a zero-allocation, single-pass identifier lexical filter (a UAX #31 analog).

SUAS-007 (SIS) is the seventh SuperUnicode Architecture Standard. It defines the two structural identifier classes — START and CONTINUE (the ID_Start / ID_Continue analogs) — plus the disjoint lexical categories of whitespace, syntax, and ignorable format controls, over the full SuperUnicode (SUCS) codepoint space. SIS is a single-pass, zero-allocation lexical filter (a UAX #31 analog): a caller resolves the class of any codepoint in O(1), or streams codepoints through a fixed-size state machine, with no heap, no regex engine, and no multi-pass scan. It governs symbol naming in the OpenWindows shell, the configuration parsers, and the nVAI scripting runtime.

Identifier classes

Class Value Meaning
SUAS_SIS_CLASS_INVALID 0 Cannot be part of an identifier
SUAS_SIS_CLASS_START 1 Valid as the initial codepoint of an identifier
SUAS_SIS_CLASS_CONTINUE 2 Valid only in a subsequent position

Identifier syntax

<Identifier> := <Start> <Continue>* — a non-empty run of an initial START codepoint followed by zero or more CONTINUE codepoints. Under the default profile, START covers letters, letter numbers, and Other_ID_Start (plus U+005F LOW LINE); CONTINUE adds marks, decimal digits, connector punctuation, and Other_ID_Continue.

Address-space treatment

Zone Range Identifier treatment
Unicode Bridge 0x00000000–0x0010FFFF UAX #31 classes via curated predicates
System Control Plane 0x00110000–0x0011FFFF Strictly invalid inside identifiers
Native plane 0x00120000–0x7FFFFFEF Admitted (RNUR / RCCR neography)
Trap slots 0x7FFFFFF0–0x7FFFFFFE Invalid
Sentinel 0x7FFFFFFF Invalid
extSUCS plugin plane above 0x7FFFFFFF Admitted (mounted plugin characters)

Lexical syntax categories

Category Value Coverage
SUAS_SIS_SYNTAX_LITERAL 0 Not whitespace, syntax, or control
SUAS_SIS_SYNTAX_WHITESPACE 1 Horizontal space (U+0009, U+0020)
SUAS_SIS_SYNTAX_LINETERM 2 Line terminators (LF–CR, NEL, LS, PS)
SUAS_SIS_SYNTAX_IGNORABLE 3 Ignorable format controls (U+200E, U+200F)
SUAS_SIS_SYNTAX_OPERATOR 4 Pattern_Syntax
SUAS_SIS_SYNTAX_CONTROL 5 SCP markers, trap slots, the Sentinel

Profiles

Profile Rule Behaviour
SUAS_SIS_PROFILE_DEFAULT R1 XID_Start / XID_Continue classes
SUAS_SIS_PROFILE_IMMUTABLE R2 Admit everything except PWS / PS / PUA / surrogate / control / noncharacter
SUAS_SIS_PROFILE_HASHTAG R8 # start; emoji and - + _ continue

Streaming state machine

suas_sis_state_t is a fixed-size, caller-owned struct of two scalar fields: is_started and length. suas_sis_feed returns true iff the codepoint was validly appended; a codepoint that cannot be appended while an identifier is in progress terminates it and resets the machine. The first codepoint must be a START character. There is no unbounded history.

Feature Status
Single-pass, O(1) per codepoint Yes
START / CONTINUE identifier classes Yes
SCP invariance (strict rejection) Yes
Native / RNUR / RCCR neography admission Yes
Pattern_White_Space / Pattern_Syntax split Yes
Default / Immutable / Hashtag profiles Yes
Zero heap allocation, fixed-size state Yes
Freestanding C99 Yes

Reference implementation: include/suas/suas_sis.h + src/suas/suas_sis.c (freestanding C99, no heap), registered in suas_static.

Source of truth: docs/suas/SUAS-007-sis.md in the repository.
